ResourceHeader.Description:
The Fermi GBM Solar Flare Catalog is a list generated by an autonomous flare finder that identifies all solar flares ≥ GOES C-Class detected by Fermi's Gamma-Ray Burst Monitor (GBM) above 10 keV.
The catalog is designed to facilitate high-energy solar physics research by logging specific physical and temporal metrics for each event.

Parameter.Name: Flare
Parameter.Description: Flare number constructed from start time of flare: yymmdd_hhmm where yy=year, mm=month, dd=day of month, hh=hour, and mm=minute, all two digits.

Parameter.Name: Start Time
Parameter.Description: Time when the synthetic rate exceeds the level corresponding to a C2 flare

Parameter.Name: Peak Time
Parameter.Description: Time of maximum rate in the 12-25 keV band

Parameter.Name: End Time
Parameter.Description: Time when the synthetic rate became less than the level corresponding to a C2 flare

Parameter.Name: Peak Rate
Parameter.Description: Maximum rate in the 12-25 keV band in counts/sec

Parameter.Name: Total counts
Parameter.Description: Total counts in the 12-25 keV band

Parameter.Name: Sunward Detectors
Parameter.Description: Four most sunward NaI detectors at the peak time (in 12-25 keV band) of the flare

Parameter.Name: Trigger
Parameter.Description: Fermi Trigger Designation if flare caused a trigger.  If there is more than one trigger during flare, this is the one nearest to the peak time.

Parameter.Name: RHESSI Flare #
Parameter.Description: The RHESSI flare designation if this flare was observed by RHESSI
